description: Start an asynchronous text-to-video or image-to-video job and return immediately with id and status. Does NOT wait for completion and does NOT auto-retry. Poll with sinogate_get_video_status, or pass callback_url for a terminal webhook.

callback_url.description: Optional public HTTPS webhook URL for terminal status. localhost/private networks are rejected by the API.

extra.description: Optional provider passthrough (bailian allowlist). Unknown keys are rejected by the API.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key header to prevent duplicate charges on replay. Reusing a key with different params returns 422.

image_url.description: Optional i2v first-frame / reference image (public HTTPS). Required for models whose id contains -i2v.

model.description: Video model ID (modalities includes video), for example wan2.6-t2v.

name: sinogate_submit_video
title: Submit a video generation job
